best_times.Meghna Cave: Late afternoon, when the cave interior is illuminated by soft natural light.
best_times.Pange Valley: Sunset, for golden light over terraced fields.
best_times.Ziro Valley Viewpoint: Sunrise, for mist-filled panoramas of the valley.
best_times.Apatani Village (Ainong): Midday, to join community farming demonstrations and interact with locals.
best_times.Talley Valley Wildlife Sanctuary: Early morning, when birds are most active and trails are dry.

safety_tips: December nights are freezing; wear thermal layers and carry a warm blanket.
Roads can be icy after night frost—drive slowly and use winter tires if possible.
Keep valuables in a lockable bag; stray dogs may roam near villages.
Carry a basic first-aid kit for minor cuts, as medical facilities are far.
tourist_traps: Avoid homestays that charge extra for basic meals; most include simple local food.
Beware of unofficial guides demanding high fees for short walks; hire certified guides only.
Skip souvenir stalls selling mass-produced ‘tribal’ items; buy directly from artisans.
Do not trek at night without a local guide; routes become unsafe after dark.
cultural_norms: Ask permission before photographing Apatani women, as modesty is highly valued.
Remove shoes when entering a local home or community hall.
Dress modestly—long sleeves and trousers are preferred, especially in villages.
Accept tea or snacks offered by hosts as a sign of respect.
local_intelligence.local_transport: Hire shared taxis from Daporijo to Ziro and use auto-rickshaws or bicycles within the valley; roads are narrow but scenic.
